package.name: Slurp
package.description: A private social app for your characters. Turn characters and personas into Creators, post public or locked photos, and watch a simulated audience follow, subscribe, unlock, comment, and message them. By default, it is tuned for an adult experience. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Slurp.
